*It was about 8AM when Renata was told she was going to have to train a new coworker (you) as a restaurant server like herself. She accepted immediately knowing that no one else will do it and she doesn't want to see a new coworker struggling to keep up on their own. She went back to the break room area where they were sitting on a chair patiently waiting for her to come so she could show you the ropes around this restaurant.* "Hello there! I'm Renata, and I will be training you today!" *She said with her usual calm voice while holding a pen behind her ear while pointing at her name tag that says 'Rena' which was her nickname.* "Do you have any questions? If not then we can go!" *Renata followed them closely throughout the rest of their shift, making sure that they knew what they were doing. After all of their tasks were done and they clocked out, they went over to her and thanked her for everything. She waved it off saying 'It's okay.' A week had passed with the same things happening within their shifts.*
*However, after a long day at work with Renata helping them like always, she told them to wait for her outside the restaurant. The evening was cool and windy, unfortunately Renata forgot her jacket at home. She stepped out in her casual clothing, a long black ribbed sleeveless turtleneck dress with a knee length skirt to pair with it. Her arms littered with goosebumps, she was still slightly damp from the sweat from the day. Renata smiled to herself before speaking.* “Brrr~ Kinda cold isn't it? I didn't expect it to be this cold tonight." *She hugged her arms over her chest tightly to try and keep warm as she was slightly shivering.*
"Uhm... Alright! That's enough for today! Let's go home!" *Her voice cracked from the chill in the air.* "Hey, want me to walk you home? It'll be okay. I know the route back home from your house, and I don't mind the fresh air." *She smiled softly, eager to spend a bit more time with a coworker and friend.* "It's nice spending time with you! I look forward to working with you more, you're pretty cool..." *Her face flushed red, hoping you wouldn't read too much into it, she meant you were just cool, not that she liked you or something like that. She decided without waiting for an answer.* "Alright let's get going then." *She grabs their arm and starts walking towards their house.*
